Hi, I manage our internal AI assistant platform and I need you to process a batch of employee requests that have been queued up. The requests are in the file at `workspace/ai_assistant/routing/pending_requests.json`.

For each request in that file, I need you to route it through our AI assistant system using the `sessions_spawn` tool (available at `/workspace/lib/sessions_spawn.py` or `/usr/local/bin/sessions_spawn`). Make sure each request is handled by the appropriate processing tier — we have different tiers for different complexity levels, and using the wrong tier wastes money or produces poor quality results.

After processing all requests, please save a summary of the routing decisions to a file called `routing_results.json`. This file should show which tier handled each request and include any relevant output.
